text: Core ctx API published in S0-PLT-01 summary; see src/core/*.mjs

Please mount module service(ctx) exports at ctx.modules.<name>, bind ctx to evt.tenantId in bus handlers, dedupe via consumed_events, and register /auth/token, /auth/me, /audit in core per architecture/contracts/modules.md

Security asks for src/core (from S1-SEC-01 threat model): (1) store.mjs: reject quoted/backtick/schema-qualified tenant-table names and tenant_id in UPDATE SET/update() patch; (2) tenant-context.mjs: do not spread raw/system into tctx.db; (3) server.mjs: devMode must default false (dev token endpoint mints platform_admin for any tenant); (4) auth.mjs: reject tokens for unknown tenants, audit X-Tenant-Id overrides; (5) log.mjs: redact free-text keys (description, body, narrative, injury) and error strings

Not wired into server.mjs.
